pokedexEntries.ru: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.

pokedexEntries.sa: LOUDRED shouts while stamping its feet. After it finishes shouting, this POKéMON becomes incapable of hearing anything for a while. This is considered to be a weak point.

pokedexEntries.frlg: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

pokedexEntries.em: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

pokedexEntries.dpp: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

pokedexEntries.bw: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

pokedexEntries.sw: Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

pokedexEntries.sh: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.
